subject: Marketplace listing: clarifications on branding, claims & support SLA
messages:
From: AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Marketplace listing preflight: branding, claims & support window

Hi Ben,

Thanks for starting the listing process for Redwood Inference. We're doing a short preflight to confirm a few items before we pull assets into the portal and publish the draft listing. Can you please confirm the following by EOD (48 hours)?

1) Branding & logos
   - We need a square and a horizontal PNG (300x300 and 1200x300) and the trademark statement you want shown in the listing.

2) Claims & product copy
   - You currently list "sub-100ms avg latency for short prompts" in some materials. We need the definitive, publi shable phrasing (no internal qualifiers) and the evidence source or benchmark report.

3) Support / SLA windows
   - Marketplace requires you to publish the support coverage that customers can expect. Options are: 24x7, Business hours, or Business hours + Critical incident coverage. Please confirm which to display and provide any escalation contact info.

4) Evidence / artifacts
   - Please attach a support matrix, SOC/Security artifacts (if available), and the latest brand guidelines.

I've attached the official marketplace requirements doc for reference. Once we have these items we can create the draft listing and run it through the compliance check.

Thanks,
Katie Nguyen
AWS Marketplace Listing Ops
aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Attachment: aws_listing_requirements.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing preflight: branding, claims & support window

Hi Katie — thanks for the clear checklist. See answers below and attached artifacts. I'll also put Marissa on copy to confirm escalation ops.

1) Branding & logos
   - Attached: brand_guidelines_2026.pdf. We'll provide the two PNG variants requested; attaching the master assets in the Drive link below as well. Preferred trademark statement: "Redwood Inference™ is a trademark of Redwood Inference, Inc."

2) Claims & product copy
   - Public phrasing we propose: "Redwood Inference provides low-latency LLM inference with deterministic routing and intelligent caching — typical median latency under 150ms for short prompts (<=64 tokens) on our hosted endpoints; latency varies by model and region."
   - Evidence: internal benchmark report (summary included in Drive). We prefer the more conservative median figure for publishing.

3) Support / SLA windows
   - Our published customer-facing support levels are: 
     • 24x7 critical-incident response (for P1 / production outages)
     • Business-hours general support (M–F, 9:00–17:00 PT) for non-critical issues
   - Escalation contact (primary, for critical incidents): Marissa Cole, Head of Customer Ops — marissa_cole@redwood.com, +1-415-555-0198
   - Secondary escalation: operations@redwood.com (monitored 24x7)

4) Evidence / artifacts
   - Attached: redwood_support_matrix_v2.xlsx (support coverage by tier), brand_guidelines_2026.pdf. SOC2 report is in process; we can provide an SOC2 letter when completed.

We are attaching a draft listing text (will send final file after minor legal check) and the support matrix. Let us know if you want tighter copy on latency.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_support_matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx); brand_guidelines_2026.pdf (pdf)

From: AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: 2026-11-21T11:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing preflight: branding, claims & support window

Ben — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few small clarifications before we proceed: 

1) "Critical incident" definition
   - In the listing we need a short parenthetical definition if you choose the Business hours + Critical option (example: "Critical incidents: complete service unavailability affecting production workloads"). Can you confirm the wording you'd like?

2) Escalation contacts
   - Please provide a preferred 24x7 phone contact or PagerDuty escalation endpoint for P1 incidents (email-only is not sufficient for P1).

3) Latency phrasing
   - The marketplace team advised to avoid sample-specific numbers unless backed by a public benchmark. Your proposed median <150ms for <=64 tokens is okay if we include "internal benchmark" as the source. Alternatively we can publish a non-numeric qualitative statement.

4) Uploads
   - Upload the logo assets and final copy to the portal. Quick guide attached.

Proposed edit for your SLA line: "24x7 critical-incident response for production outages (see escalation contacts); business-hours general support (M–F, 9:00–17:00 PT)."

Attachment: portal_upload_instructions.txt (txt)

Let us know the P1 phone/PagerDuty endpoint and the short critical-incident definition and we can proceed to create the draft listing and run the compliance check.

Best,
Katie Nguyen
AWS Marketplace Listing Ops

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:55:00-08:00
Subject: FW: Marketplace listing preflight: branding, claims & support window

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding AWS' note. Quick asks so we can close this out: 

- Marissa: can you confirm the P1 escalation path we want published (phone number + PagerDuty URL)? If legal needs to pre-approve the critical-incident definition line, flag it and I'll loop in legal.
- Karthik: legal asked whether the latency claim should be labeled "internal benchmark" versus referencing a public report. Which is lower risk?

HubSpot deal: HS-29872 — AWS listing is a gating item for our co-sell motion. We should get this live this week if possible.

Ben
Attachment: (none)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Katie Nguyen <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Katie Feldman <katie.feldman@acme-ai.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Final: listing copy and escalation contacts for Redwood Inference

Hi Katie — following internal checks, we are good to proceed. Final items attached and answers below.

1) Critical-incident definition (as requested): "Critical incidents: complete service unavailability or any issue causing data loss or significant production impact to customer workloads."

2) Escalation / P1 endpoint
   - Primary escalation: Marissa Cole (PagerDuty): https://pagerduty.com/redsrv/Redwood-P1 (P1 escalation URL)
   - Primary phone (24x7): +1-415-555-0198
   - Secondary: operations@redwood.com (monitored 24x7)

3) Published SLA phrasing (final): "24x7 critical-incident response for production outages (see escalation contacts); business-hours general support (M–F, 9:00–17:00 PT)."

4) Latency claim
   - We will publish: "Typical median latency under 150ms for short prompts (<=64 tokens) — internal benchmark."

Attachments: redwood_listing_text_v1.docx (docx), escalation_contacts.csv (csv)

Please confirm once the draft listing is created and the assets are uploaded to the portal. HubSpot: HS-29872; Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-marketplace-assets

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
